Title: Line numbers in Log Analytics query editor

Body.Content:
We have added the ability to view line numbers in Log Analytics query editor!

This feature works in tandem with our revamped error messages allowing quicker and easier debugging of queries:

You may toggle the line numbers in your query editor using Log Analytics settings.

We appreciate your feedback. If you have questions or suggestions, please email us.
